"Fires in the Calais camp are just a tradition of the migrant population" declares French official

In a interview with a French TV news stations, Fabienne Buccio, prefect of the department, explained that it was basically a custom of the migrant population to burn their house when leaving, to clean up. It was unfortunate but has to be accepted and is not a surprise. And since she was aware of this, firemen were standing ready and some tents were destroyed before to avoid the fire propagating.

It's even a good news because she explains that "it shows that the migrants now understand that Calais camp is finished".

The journalist asks "but could you not explain them that it's not a good idea ?" And she replies that community leaders told that it was a strong traditions, "when we leave we clean up, and we clean up with fire".

Note that other articles write that some associations working in the camp are furious and don't agree at all, and tell they never heard of this tradition and that's it just an expression of violence. Most media report that what the prefect said was completely stupid.
